title: The Pigeon: a past life story
html:
• Jātaka Stories of Past Lives 42
  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones
  • Atthakāmavagga Wanting to Help

2. Kapotajātaka The Pigeon: a past life story

“Yo atthakāmassa hitānukampino, One who does not follow advice when instructed Ovajjamāno na karoti sāsanaṁ; by an ally who wants to help, Kapotakassa vacanaṁ akatvā, not following the pigeon’s counsel, Amittahatthatthagatova setī”ti. ends up in the hands of their foes.

Kapotajātakaṁ dutiyaṁ.
